items.title: Home Depot or Lowe’s: Which Dividend Grower Wins for Long-Term Income?
items.summary: Barron's just downgraded Lowe's to Sell, yet the cheaper stock boasts faster dividend hikes and a fatter cushion. With housing stuck in a slump, retirees must decide which payout deserves their trust. The answer splits three ways.

items.title: 4 Dividend Kings That Kept Raising Payouts Through Recessions and High Interest Rates
items.summary: Four Dividend Kings raised payouts through a financial crisis, zero rates, and the sharpest hikes in decades. Only one yields above 5%, and its thin cash flow makes the next raise the one to watch.
